limits: Native Windows 11 build/install/import/upgrade acceptance remains NOT_RUN for the user.
Production services, DB migrations, app releases and published downloads were not changed.
Core multi-hop policy uses real HTTP/PostgreSQL with signed loopback app fixtures. SDK transport uses actual loopback TCP tests; end-to-end deployed Docker/public-origin SDK calls are NOT_RUN.
Server-build API fixture does not execute Docker compilation; final-build DB-history delay/revocation was corrected by source review and not fault-injected during a real compilation.
Only delegated user credentials are implemented; service-account issuance and recursive user delegation are unsupported.
Revocation is checked at request/execution/checkpoint boundaries; already completed side effects are not rolled back and running work is not universally forcibly canceled.
New-host installation, whole-host capacity/load/OOM enforcement, backup/restore/updater and full V7 remain later stages.
